categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: The change modifies signing logic in src/script/sign.cpp; changes to the behavior an RPC merely exposes are excluded from RPC.
categories.rationale: RPC is only matched via test/functional/rpc_psbt.py; the underlying change is to signing and PSBT handling, not RPC machinery.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches PSBT signing logic used by wallet signing flows such as walletprocesspsbt.
categories.rationale: Prevents unintended fund redirection when signing PSBTs with SIGHASH_SINGLE. As noted in the description, signing an input without a corresponding output produces a signature that commits to no outputs at all, creating 'a footgun that lets funds be redirected without the owner's consent.'
